scope.description: One synchronous Raft.GetConfiguration call on a node whose latest configuration is committed, compared with the index at which that configuration was written.
assumptions: the caller may call GetConfiguration from any goroutine, as the API documents
the latest configuration index is observable on the same node
excluded: the Configuration() contents, which are served from the atomic copy
the configurationsCh path used by snapshot creation, which fills both fields

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: election/heartbeat/lease timeouts are shortened and the log level is raised to ERROR so the single-voter election completes quickly
the harness reads the live latest configuration index for the probe and the public API readout for the result; no target source is replaced

plan_uncertainties: The check observes one committed single-voter configuration; a later configuration change would keep the same constructor behaviour but is not exercised here.
grounding_unresolved: External consumers of the reported index cannot be checked from this snapshot
Whether any consumer outside this repository depends on the reported index is not observable from the snapshot.
